open_points.subject: surface.serve_kernel startup sequence
open_points.text: "`surface.serve_kernel` runs the start in this order: `installation.load_installation`; `bindings.check_installed_instances`; `store.open_store` ..." vs "The order of process start: installation, store, sandbox probe, `in_flight` recovery, run recovery, and only then the first request"
open_points.question: Is `bindings.check_installed_instances` a required startup step, and if so exactly where in the startup order does it run?
options: Not a separate step (folded into another module call)
open_points.default_guess: Required, between installation load and store open, because that order is stated explicitly with call names.

open_points.subject: Inspection read path ownership (surface vs owning modules)
open_points.text: "`surface` ... assembles every read ... from the owning modules' read capabilities and `store.page_records`" and "The one exception is `surface` returning records as they are ... which it reads through `store`"
open_points.question: For each inspectable type, when must `surface` call an owning module read capability versus reading raw records via `store`?
options: `surface` may read raw records for any display-only list, using owning modules only for computed views
Every inspectable type must have an owning-module read capability; `store` paging is only a storage primitive
Hybrid per type, explicitly enumerated in State 3
open_points.default_guess: Use raw `store` reads for display-only records and owning-module capabilities only for computed/derived answers.
